title: AnimationTree: BlendSpace2D hallucinates Animation values
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in Godot_v4.6.3-stable_win64.exe, no other Versions tested.

### System information

Godot v4.6.3.stable - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 3 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.8134) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-13420H (12 threads) - 15.70 GiB memory

### Issue description

See player_cat.tscn, player_cat.gd

I am starting with Godot and was experimenting with 2D character animation. I wanted to use a AnimationTree to set the Animation in an AnimatedSprite2D. For that I created an AnimationPlayer that has 5 Animations:
idle, walk_left, walk_right, walk_up, walk_down

These Animations set the value of Animation in the AnimatedSprite2D and are called in the node "Walk" in the AnimationTree. 

But when the game runs and I press two keys together, e.g. right and down, the debugger shows this message:

E 0:24:01:915   player_cat.gd:8 @ _physics_process(): There is no animation with name 'walk_klokq'.
  <C++ Error>   Condition "!frames->get_animation_names().has(name)" is true.
  <C++ Source>  scene/2d/animated_sprite_2d.cpp:485 @ play()
  <Stack Trace> player_cat.gd:8 @ _physics_process()

But there is no Animation that uses the value 'walk_klokq'.

By the way, I like your work. I used Unity for quite a time, but I'm switching now to Godot because it's so fast and lightweight. Keep up the good work!

### Steps to reproduce

Run Project, press [down] + [right] simultanously, see Debugger for Errors.
Also always happens when you press keys for moving diagonally.
